sections.heading: Loss details
fields: Willow Crossing Marketplace parking lot, Willow Crossing, UT

sections.heading: What happened (in your own words)
sections.paragraph: I parked my truck in the Willow Crossing Marketplace lot and went into the hardware store. When I came back out about 40 minutes later, the driver side rear door was dented and scraped and there was a long scrape along the side of the bed behind it. Whoever hit it did not leave a note and I did not see the other vehicle. I called the Willow Crossing police and an officer came out and gave me a report number. The truck drives fine and the rear door still opens and closes.
